id.description: The unique identifier for the comment.

from.description: Information about the user who posted the comment.

id.description: The unique identifier for the user who posted the comment.

username.description: The username of the user who posted the comment.

timestamp.description: The date and time when the comment was created.

text.description: The text content of the comment.

like_count.description: The number of likes the comment has received.

parent_id.description: The ID of the parent comment if this is a reply, null for top-level comments.

media_id.description: The ID of the media post this comment belongs to.

page_id.description: The ID of the Facebook page associated with this comment.

business_account_id.description: The ID of the Instagram business account associated with this comment.

post_id.description: Alias for media_id to match existing data structure.

from_id.description: The ID of the user who posted the comment (flattened from 'from' object).

from_username.description: The username of the user who posted the comment (flattened from 'from' object).

extracted_at.description: The timestamp when this comment data was extracted.

is_reply.description: Boolean indicating whether this is a reply to another comment.
